messages:
Emma_CS: Heads up — getting several reports from customers that the per-model RPS panels in Console flattened out around 09:10 UTC. Panels show a single near-constant line instead of per-model series. Affected both hosted and dedicated orgs.
Mike_Support: Filed INC-3421 for Acme Corp, sent initial note. They said the total throughput still looks ok but the per-model lines disappeared. Attached screenshot.
Carla_SRE: I see a metrics-exporter rollout at 09:05 in infra logs that changed a metric dimension name. Suspect: exporter renamed label 'model_id' -> 'model_label' in v2.1 and dashboards still query model_id.
Josh_Platform: If that's true panels would return empty series for model_id. Can you confirm with Prometheus queries?
Carla_SRE: Running quick checks:
```
# returns nothing
count by (model_id) (rate(model_inference_requests[1m]))
# returns per-model series
count by (model_label) (rate(model_inference_requests[1m]))
```
Results: model_id buckets are empty, model_label has expected series (acme-embed-v1, acme-chat-2, ...).
Alice: Thanks — that matches symptoms. Console dashboard panels were hard-coded to filter/stack by model_id.
Mike_Support: Update to customers: "We're investigating; root cause appears to be an internal metric dimension rename. We'll have a remediation shortly." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Josh_Platform: Two remediation options: 1) patch dashboards to use model_label (lots of panels & orgs risk), or 2) deploy a compatibility hotfix to exporter that duplicates model_label -> model_id (safe quick restore). Which do we want?
Carla_SRE: I'll prepare a hotfix that re-emits model_id alongside model_label so dashboards keep working. Minimal change, no DB migrations. Need approval for a rolling restart of metrics-exporter on prometheus scrape targets. ETA ~20m to rollout and verify.
Emma_CS: +1 for hotfix. Inform customers and ETA. Also add follow-up to update dashboards to accept either label.
infra-bot: deploy started: metrics-exporter v2.1.1-hotfix by carla_sre — pipeline #4423.
Carla_SRE: Hotfix deployed to canary and then prod. Verifying Prometheus now:
```
# after hotfix
count by (model_id) (rate(model_inference_requests[1m]))
# -> returns series: acme-embed-v1, acme-chat-2, etc.
```
Carla_SRE: Confirmed per-model series restored in Prometheus and Grafana. Pushing a quick dashboard cache refresh in Console.
Mike_Support: Notified Acme that graphs should be back — they confirm per-model panels show lines again. Marking INC-3421 as mitigated, monitoring.
Emma_CS: Great work, thanks. Keep an eye for any drift for 1h, then we can close.
Josh_Platform: Follow-up task created PLAT-872 to make Console dashboards resilient: accept model_id or model_label (label_replace fallback), add tests, and require export compatibility policy for future metric dimension changes. Assigning to me.
Alice: Also add an alert if a new metric dimension removes an expected label (prevent silent breakage).
Carla_SRE: Logged postmortem notes and timeline in the incident doc. Will link after cleanup.
Emma_CS: Closing loop with customers now. :white_check_mark:
